description: Front of building - replacement of lower ground floor window with door and replacement of door with window, replace ground floor entrance surface with Portland Stone; Courtyard - replacement of lower ground floor window with doors and block up adjacent existing door; replace external steps from lower to upper level; replace and widen existing glazed door and window openings at upper ground floor; rebuild lower ground floor single storey room to form plant room; Rear - replace modern rear window at third floor with timber casement window, replace boundary treatments to terraces and install pergola; internal alternations and refurbishment at all floors, including installation of mechanical cooling to bedrooms. (Revised proposals following grant of planning permission PP/26/01314 and listed building consent LB/26/01315)
